title: Persistent-state address-path diagnosis for the integrated multimodal PLM chain
question: Is the E2E-001 failure caused primarily by the learned persistent-state write path, the learned read path, or the use of incompatible write/read address spaces?
hypothesis: Providing an explicit entity address to the persistent write path, read path, or both will localize the E2E-001 addressing failure; the strongest improvement is expected when both persistent-state paths use the same explicit entity address.

arms.name: explicit_write
arms.intervention: use the observed entity identity as the persistent-state write address while retaining learned query-time read addressing

arms.name: explicit_read
arms.intervention: use the query entity identity as the persistent-state read address while retaining learned observation-time write addressing

arms.name: explicit_both
arms.intervention: use the observed entity identity for writes and the query entity identity for reads

endpoints.name: heldout_q2_accuracy_explicit_both
endpoints.role: primary — held-out q2 accuracy with explicit entity addressing on both state paths

endpoints.name: write_target_address_accuracy
endpoints.role: secondary diagnostic — learned/write intervention address assignment

decision_rule.condition: all integrity checks pass and explicit_both mean q2 accuracy is at least 0.80 with every seed at least 0.40
decision_rule.licenses: explicit entity-addressed persistent state satisfies the registered synthetic capability criterion
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal capability, semantic retrieval, arbitrary learned operators, or scaling

decision_rule.condition: explicit_both passes integrity but fails the primary criterion
decision_rule.licenses: the address-path intervention does not meet the criterion; the explicit_write and explicit_read arms are retained for localization
decision_rule.does_not_license: that persistent state or PLM is impossible

decision_rule.condition: explicit_write materially recovers q2 while explicit_read does not
decision_rule.licenses: evidence localizing the E2E-001 failure toward learned persistent writing
decision_rule.does_not_license: a general claim about memory systems

decision_rule.condition: explicit_read materially recovers q2 while explicit_write does not
decision_rule.licenses: evidence localizing the E2E-001 failure toward learned persistent reading
decision_rule.does_not_license: a general claim about memory systems

decision_rule.condition: explicit_both materially recovers q2 while either single-path intervention does not
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that coherence between write and read addressing is the relevant interface
decision_rule.does_not_license: a general claim about semantic addressing

decision_rule.condition: a train/eval composition overlap or answer leakage is detected
decision_rule.licenses: instrument invalid and no scientific interpretation

held_constant: same 12 complementary latent bits as E2E-001
text bits 0-3, image bits 4-7, audio bits 8-11
same eight held-out canonical operator/index compositions as E2E-001
same evaluation episode generator and seed set
the E2E-001 result mean=0.5200 is a frozen diagnostic comparator, not a re-fit baseline
